Hi Fazrath,

I think they just wanted you to give some examples of companies e.g. "We have car manufacturers such as Ford and Toyota". 'Private and public' was a bit too general - the examiner wanted to hear more information.

Just say that you learnt science at secondary school, and give an example of what you did in science lessons.

comments.text:
Hi Rawan,

It doesn't mean that you failed - I think the examiner just decided that there wasn't enough time to explain and do the last question, so don't worry about it.

Examiners give 4 different scores (with no 0.5 scores) - the 0.5 scores are the result of adding the 4 different scores together and finding the average.

I think 5.7 would be 5.5 and 5.75 would be 6.

Hope this helps
